children: Revolut said it plans to invest more than 150 million Swiss francs ($183.2 million) in Switzerland over the next five years after applying for a local banking license.

The digital bank said Wednesday that it had applied for a local banking license from the country's financial regulator, which would allow it to offer a complete range of banking services in Switzerland. The application is currently under review.
As part of its long-term plan to develop an independent Swiss banking entity, the bank will make several appointments to its executive board and senior leadership team, it said.
Revolut has already more than 1.3 million customers in the country.
